rows.notes: Context: Hokushin ambushes Akito, orders Minato killed and Ruri captured for genetic experiments; Ruri identifies the kidnapping squad. Ruri is the golden-eyed little girl; Lapis comparison and human creation accusation preserved.

rows.en: Earthlings seem terribly fond of tampering with genes. ...Like the now-extinct Tekkoryu (Iron Dragon).

rows.en: You shall become the foundation of glorious research in our organization's laboratory.

rows.notes: Context: Hokushin ambushes Akito, orders Minato killed and Ruri captured for genetic experiments; Ruri identifies the kidnapping squad.

rows.en: Indeed... We are the shadow of the Martian Successors. Humans who have strayed from humanity's path. Fiends.
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin ambushes Akito, orders Minato killed and Ruri captured for genetic experiments; Ruri identifies the kidnapping squad.

rows.en: All for a new order...!
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin ambushes Akito, orders Minato killed and Ruri captured for genetic experiments; Ruri identifies the kidnapping squad.

rows.en: Ha ha ha ha ha!

rows.en: Who goes there!?
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: A new order... How laughable.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: ...Indeed, a new order is born only after destruction and chaos. Thus, suffering the pangs of its birth is inevitable.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: But! Kusakabe has no virtue.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: It's been a long time, Genichiro Tsukiomi. Fine words from a traitor who sold out Jupiter...
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: Yes. I betrayed my friends, betrayed Jupiter... And now I'm Nergal's dog.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.
Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: ...It's been a long time, Minato.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved. Speaker remains source-hidden ??? despite later Goat reply.

rows.en: Huh? What!? Where did you come from!?
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: From behind a grave.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: Oh, right... Ah ha ha...
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: This is where the dead sleep. It should be a place of peace... Surrender quietly, Hokushin.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: And if I don't?
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: You'll go to hell.
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: Will I? ...Reppu!
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved. Reppu is a named member addressed; campaign_terms provisional romanization.
uncertain: Reppu canonical English spelling unestablished; existing provisional glossary form retained.

rows.en: Yeah! Shaaaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.
Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: Gwaaah!!
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved. Uses established Jovian-style sword drawing; distinction is martial art versus assassination blade, not an invented attack.

rows.en: No way!
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: Mokuren-style jujutsu...
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved. Akito identifies Tsukiomi's established martial art in a deliberate noun phrase.
uncertain: Retained source technique-identification fragment.

rows.en: Huh!?
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: Your wicked blade cannot defeat my jujutsu. Hokushin, surrender!
rows.notes: Context: Tsukiomi and Goat intervene at cemetery; betrayal, new order, and sword/jujutsu distinction preserved.

rows.en: ...Jump.
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin escapes by individual jump; Akito warns of Yurika's coercion and approaching offensive before offering Ruri a keepsake.

rows.en: A Boson Jump...!
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin escapes by individual jump; Akito warns of Yurika's coercion and approaching offensive before offering Ruri a keepsake.

rows.en: A solo... Boson Jump.
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin escapes by individual jump; Akito warns of Yurika's coercion and approaching offensive before offering Ruri a keepsake. Deliberate noun-phrase reaction to individual jump.
uncertain: Retained source reaction fragment.

rows.en: ...They've broken Yurika.
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin escapes by individual jump; Akito warns of Yurika's coercion and approaching offensive before offering Ruri a keepsake. Source おとした means broke/subdued Yurika into usable navigator; preceding enemy experiment confirms coercion. Does not mean killed.
uncertain: Interpretive choice: broke Yurika for おとした, grounded in source experiment/control context.

rows.en: Huh?
Kusakabe's major offensive is near too... So...
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin escapes by individual jump; Akito warns of Yurika's coercion and approaching offensive before offering Ruri a keepsake. Reason trails into next Ruri prompt and Akito gift.
uncertain: Retained source trailing reason at row boundary.

rows.en: So?
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin escapes by individual jump; Akito warns of Yurika's coercion and approaching offensive before offering Ruri a keepsake.  Retained source one-word follow-up question to trailing reason.
uncertain: Retained source one-word follow-up question to trailing reason.

rows.en: There's something I want to give you.
rows.notes: Context: Hokushin escapes by individual jump; Akito warns of Yurika's coercion and approaching offensive before offering Ruri a keepsake.

rows.en: This is... the recipe for Tenkawa's special ramen...
rows.notes: Recipe received from Akito at239; deliberate identification fragment retained. Source-fragment flag: unfinished identification.

rows.en: I... I can't accept this!
You'll need it when you get Yurika back, Akito!
I don't need it anymore.
The Akito Tenkawa you knew is dead... I want you to take this as proof that he lived.
rows.notes: Metaphorical death of the Akito Ruri knew, not factual death; proof of his life retained.

rows.en: You're trying to look cool.
rows.notes: Ruri accuses Akito of posing; next explanation rejects it.

rows.en: That's not it, Ruri...
Their experiments messed up my head. It all started after that...
rows.notes: Akito describes experiments and damage to his head, not merely emotional trauma.
Source punctuation-only exclamation retained.

rows.en: My sense of taste, especially... It's gone.
When my emotions run high, I give off a faint glow. Like a comic book, huh?
rows.notes: Glow refers to Akito himself when emotions rise.

rows.en: I can never make ramen for you again...

rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: countdown.

rows.en: Operation Bagration, Phase 1, begin!
The time has come. Have all the old Nadesico crew assembled?
Yes. All the paperwork is complete, too.
So... we just take the Nahel Argama to Nergal's lunar factory, right?
That's right. We'll pick up the Nadesico C there.
The enemies we're most likely to encounter on our way to the Moon are Giganos and the Martian Successors...
Yes.
...This ship launches in one hour. Everyone, take your stations.
Yes.
rows.notes: Neutral Yes works for authorization at s0210:487 and receiving further orders at i021a:2.

rows.en: Hey! Long time no see, everyone! How've you been?
Hey, you haven't changed a bit, either.
You volunteered to join the Nadesico C too, Yukina?
Yep, that's right!
Wait, wait! What are you doing here?!
Minato, you really thought you could leave without telling me?
Who told you about this?!
Isn't that obvious?
rows.notes: Question leaves the informant unnamed;268 likewise avoids naming someone from later knowledge.

rows.en: Yeah, it had to be that guy...
rows.notes: Informant deliberately source-short that guy; no unsupported name added.

rows.en: Hee hee... You got it.
You've got school! Go home, right now!
It's summer vacation.
rows.notes: School vacation answers Minato, not permission to board.

rows.en: What about your club?! You've got the national school tournament!
That was canceled as soon as that ghost city showed up.
You idiot! Go home!
Now, hold on.

rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: reaction.

rows.en: There's a reason I brought her aboard.
A reason?!
rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: echo question.

rows.en: Yes. To avoid needless trouble before departure.
Needless?!
rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: echo question.

rows.en: Just listen. She's the sister of the Jovian hero, Tsukumo Shiratori.
rows.notes: Yukina is Tsukumo Shiratori's younger sister; sibling relationship retained.

rows.en: She could be the Martian Successors' next target. Leaving her alone would be more dangerous.
Oh...
rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: reaction.

rows.en: He's got a point. Come on, let's hurry up and get ready!
There they go... Everyone from #部隊名...
uncertain: Retained trailing crew identification.

rows.en: This time, we're the ones seeing them off...

rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: silence.

rows.en: Houmei, Pros... It's been a while.
rows.notes: Hidden speaker label remains ???; Pros is source-short glossary nickname.

rows.en: You're...
rows.notes: Recognition trails off; no hidden identity supplied. Source-fragment flag: unfinished recognition.
uncertain: Retained unfinished identification.

rows.en: I had her stay on Earth for another assignment.
Another assignment?
rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: echo question.

rows.en: Well, shall we go...?

rows.notes: Context verified against full-source event and adjacent rows; speaker register and direction preserved.

rows.en: Subaru... is in a bad mood...
rows.notes: Machine speech tic rendered through colloquial wording; sama dropped.

rows.en: Is it because Ogre's pilot got away? Is he still mad about that?
Subaru... was close to that guy, right? That's why he's even madder, right?
rows.notes: Hokuto is the guy from294/298; supported gender from full profile; relationship retained.

rows.en: What's wrong, Subaru? You don't seem to be feeling well...
You said... you had him reborn, didn't you?
rows.notes: Claims rebirth of Hokuto, not literal birth; Subaru quotes Zero's claim. Final review: Natural English for the same quoted rebirth claim; restores Zero as acting subject without changing claim.

rows.en: Then why?! Why did he... Why did Hokuto get his memories back?!
I did indeed say that. However, it seems I failed.
Our inability to recover Ogre is quite a miscalculation as well, but I'm afraid it cannot be helped.
Hokuto...
rows.notes: Context and addressee checked against original neighboring occurrences; natural full rendering.

rows.en: So this is of no use anymore, either...
rows.notes: Demonstrative this remains unidentified; no invented object. Source-fragment flag: indefinite demonstrative; object not identified.

rows.en: And... there is little time left now...
Subaru, I shall launch the next operation.
As things stand, we must destroy Ogre as an enemy alongside Dendoh. Please understand that, Subaru.
rows.notes: Ogre and Dendoh are units; Subaru is listener; sama dropped.

rows.en: Wait, Zero... ...I'll go...!
You, Subaru?
rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: echo question.

rows.en: If we're going to fight Ogre, I'll go...
But...
rows.notes: Source-fragment flag: interrupted objection.
uncertain: Retained interrupted contrast.

rows.en: Shut up! If we're going to destroy him... destroy Ogre, I'll do it myself, with my own hands!
rows.notes: Self-correction from him to Ogre retained; resolve action subject Subaru.

rows.en: ...Very well. Then I shall make the arrangements...
...The time is ripe. Tomorrow at 1200, we will put Plan A into action.
rows.notes: Plan A is provisional rendition of first-stem codename; flagged pending term decision. Root term/context review: Provisional literal Plan A; no exact Akurasu or licensed wording located.
uncertain: Provisional literal Plan A; no exact Akurasu or licensed wording located.

rows.en: So you're finally making your move. That means you can now control the Boson Jump system?
Yes. Using a translator called Yurika Misumaru.
rows.notes: Translator describes Yurika as apparatus; deliberate dehumanization retained.

rows.en: The former Nadesico captain who brought the Lizard War to an end is now a source of chaos in the Earth Sphere...
Heh heh heh... How ironic.
Now we can turn the tables in one stroke.
Indeed. If you send mobile weapons to political centers across Earth by Boson Jump...
rows.notes: Conditional sentence continues into318; do not finish it prematurely. Source-fragment flag: sentence continues in318.
uncertain: Retained conditional leading into next row.

rows.en: You can deal a fatal blow to the Earth Federation and its forces, already in chaos over the MU's airborne city.
Then it will be easy for my Giganos to reverse our disadvantage.
However, there is one matter that concerns me.
What is it?
#部隊名. According to the information our spies obtained...
rows.notes: Deliberate source fragment; intelligence sentence continues in323. Placeholder remains verbatim.
uncertain: Retained deliberate source fragment / row-spanning incomplete predicate. Deliberate source fragment; intelligence sentence continues in323. Placeholder remains verbatim.

rows.en: A new Nadesico-class ship is being prepared for them.
What is there to fear from a new Nadesico model?
You control the Hisago Plan and the ruins, and they have no A-Class Jumpers, who are needed for Boson Jump.
rows.notes: Preserve Dorchenov's false belief that the enemy has no A-Class Jumpers; no correction from earlier Inez/Hari scene.

rows.en: Besides, I hear that even Zeorymer cannot jump all the way to Mars...
rows.notes: Reports inability to jump to Mars; not a general claim Zeorymer cannot teleport.

rows.en: In other words, they still cannot make jumps over extreme distances. Our victory is as good as assured, is it not?
...I want to take every precaution. I shall have you annihilate #部隊名 and the new Nadesico.
rows.notes: Kusakabe asks Dorchenov to annihilate the force; direction preserved.

rows.en: Hmph... I intended to do that without being told, but I will not do it for nothing.
I understand. I will send Shishiki to you as well.
Very well. Then we shall make the first move. Make sure you overlook nothing on your end, either.
...All for the sake of a new order.
rows.notes: Deliberate source slogan fragment retained.
uncertain: Retained deliberate source fragment / row-spanning incomplete predicate. Deliberate source slogan fragment retained.

rows.en: Heh heh heh... All the time I spent enduring life in this shoal zone was worth it.
rows.notes: Shoal zone has official Gundam stem support; exact licensed MX rendition remains unverified.
uncertain: Shoal zone has official Gundam stem support; exact licensed MX rendition remains unverified.

rows.en: ...Report the Federation Space Force's current movements.
rows.notes: Federation Space Force is source-derived combined-setting wording; exact licensed MX organization wording unverified.
uncertain: Federation Space Force is source-derived combined-setting wording; exact licensed MX organization wording unverified.

rows.en: Yes, sir. The enemy is concentrating its forces in four sectors of space.
Hmm... They intend to strike this mobile fortress and the Vegan Empire's bases simultaneously?
And what of #部隊名?
rows.notes: Question restores predicate about the force's status.

rows.en: We believe they are preparing to launch their mothership from Earth to head for one of those points.
I see...
...Nergal Heavy Industries is in the Moon's protected zone... They intend to head straight there.
Good... Track #部隊名's movements and dispatch a special interception force. Include those mass-produced machines.
A-are you sure, sir? Their adjustments are not yet complete...
rows.notes: Adjustments remain incomplete; source trails off, but English restores predicate.

rows.en: It does not matter. I will stop at nothing to defeat #部隊名.
And... we will use her as well.
rows.notes: Later346 identifies demonstrative as a woman; her resolved without naming before revelation.

rows.en: Who do you mean, sir...?
rows.notes: Resolves whom from346 rather than adding name.

rows.en: That woman we searched every inch of the place to find, so we could defeat the Dragonars.
rows.notes: Woman is not named until360; keep source concealment.

rows.en: U-understood, sir.
Heh heh heh... The next battle will be settled quickly.
The Federation may have the advantage in numbers, but it cannot withstand pinpoint attacks using Boson Jump...
Then all that remains... is how to dispose of the Jovian ghosts infesting Mars.
rows.notes: Jovian ghosts means the Martian Successors, contempt retained without replacing source epithet.

rows.en: ...Heh heh heh... I am glad to see you looking well. Are you satisfied with how my soldiers have treated you?
There is a request I would very much like you to hear today...
I would like your help in bringing this war to an earlier end.
You see, I dislike battles in which the difference in strength is so clear.
rows.notes: Dorchenov's false peace claim preserved; coercion not added.

rows.en: So I would like you to call on the enemy for a ceasefire. Tell them that we are ready to accept those who surrender...
rows.notes: Source trails off in instruction about accepting surrender; English restores tell them, keeping trailing ellipsis.

rows.en: ...What are you really after? Why did you go to the trouble of bringing me here from the prisoner-of-war camp...?!
rows.notes: Hidden speaker remains ??? until source revelation; prisoner-of-war camp retained.

rows.en: No, no, I have no ulterior motive. I only want you to broadcast a call for a ceasefire to the Federation.
Your voice as the female controller of the space colony Alucard...
rows.notes: Source incomplete predicate retained; sentence continues359, controller explicitly female.
uncertain: Retained deliberate source fragment / row-spanning incomplete predicate. Source incomplete predicate retained; sentence continues359, controller explicitly female.

rows.en: Is already familiar to many people... and has dignity and authority as well.
rows.notes: Deliberate continuation fragment completing358; English voice subject in358.
uncertain: Retained deliberate source fragment / row-spanning incomplete predicate. Deliberate continuation fragment completing358; English voice subject in358.

rows.en: That is why, Aoi Wakaba... your voice is fitting for delivering a call for a ceasefire.
Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
